verdict.rationale: Puzzle has built-in AI features (Accounting AI, AI Close agents), so letting users plug external MCP servers into those agents is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents the opposite direction: a Puzzle MCP server that connects Puzzle's data to Claude. That is server-side and does not show Puzzle consuming third-party MCP tools, so there is no evidence it delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
